root_cause: Incorrect ordering of two dimension-setting operations: the aligned coded_width/coded_height assignment happened before a call to ff_set_dimensions(), which itself also assigns (unaligned) values to those same fields, silently overwriting the alignment performed just before it.
findings: In decode_frame() of the newly added ProRes RAW decoder, avctx->coded_width and avctx->coded_height are set to the 16-byte aligned values of the parsed frame width/height BEFORE the call to ff_set_dimensions(avctx, w, h). ff_set_dimensions() internally resets avctx->coded_width and avctx->coded_height back to the unaligned width/height (w, h) whenever the resolution changes from the previous frame
